one_line: The paper develops and validates an ensemble deep-learning model to forecast short-term electricity consumption in four space types of a real educational (school) building in Auckland; continuous-industry sectors (steel, iron, chemicals, a polyethylene plant) appear only as a future-application aspiration and a cited reference, not as the study's demonstrated context.
